name: W1 Short — Confluence Model

large_gap.desc: Gap down 100+ pts counts as bonus confluence on top of gap_down

confluence_model.note: Count: gap_down, large_gap (bonus), overnight_down, prior_day_down, bearish_930. More confluences = bigger target.

description: The master W1 short playbook. Count your pre-market confluences plus the 9:30 candle. Scale TP from 1R to 3R+ as confluences stack.
action_plan: Night before: count pre-market confluences (gap down, large gap 100+, overnight down, prior day weak). At 9:30:30: did the candle close bearish? Final count → look up tier → size and TP accordingly.

name: FVGC Off of 930 Candle
description: FVG created in the first 90 seconds of RTH (9:29:30–9:31:00). Take the short FVGC entry. 74% WR standalone — structural edge from the opening burst.
action_plan: Watch for FVG formation in 9:29:30–9:31:00 window on 30s bars. Take the short. If 2+ W1 confluences also present, hold for higher R.

name: No News + Macro 1 Short
description: On days with no high-impact news, short FVGC entries in Macro 1 achieve 75% WR when combined with wide OR.
action_plan: Check economic calendar. If clean day (no red folder), shorts in macro 1 have a structural edge. Combine with wide OR for 75% WR.

name: FVGC To Opening Range H/L
description: After the 15-min OR is set, OR high and OR low become magnetic levels. 94% chance one side gets swept before 10:15 (avg time 7 min).
action_plan: At 9:45: note the 15-min OR high and low. Take FVGC entries toward whichever side structure favors. 94% one side swept before 10:15.

name: Reversal-Confirmed FVG Continuation (HTF 15m Sweep)
description: Sweep of unmitigated 15m FVG + opposing FVG inversion → FVGC reversal entry. 68% at 1R, median MFE 6.4R.
action_plan: Identify unmitigated 15m FVGs pre-market. If one gets swept (non-reclaiming) and an opposing FVG inverts, take the FVGC reversal signal.

name: 15m FVG Breakout Continuation
description: Price breaks through 15m FVG (continuation, not reversal). 93.3% WR at 1R on 40 trades. Median MFE 8.7R. Only works on 15m FVGs.
action_plan: Watch for price breaking through (not bouncing off) a 15m FVG. If opposing FVG inverts, take FVGC in the break direction. Hold — these run hard.
